description: This pixel art character is a solid bright green mannequin. The bright green color is intentional (a chroma key) and must stay exactly the same bright green in every frame. Add only a steel sword, held in the character's right hand, pointing down and slightly outward; exactly one weapon, no other weapons, no scabbard, no shield; the arms stay exactly as they are, drawn in its own natural colors (no bright green on the item), identical design in all frames. Cells in order: 1 cells rest facing south (front view). Keep every other pixel, the pose, the outline and the transparent background unchanged.
